title: Rory and the Velvet Valley Stream
verses:
The stars started winking above in the sky,
As Rory walked slowly to rest by the stream.
Nia flew gently while drifting on high,
To whisper that night was beginning to dream.

Soft moss had grown thick on the edge of the shore,
Where Benny reclined with a deep, happy sigh.
And Tilly was tucking green leaves on the floor,
Beneath the grey clouds floating lazily by.

Then Ricky hopped over to settle right down,
And curled in a nest made of cedar and pine.
While Psittaco rested upon his soft crown,
Where blossoms released a calm scent so divine.

Blue fireflies danced in the shadowy glade,
They hummed a soft tune as the twilight grew deep.
The cool silver light cast a comforting shade,
To rock all the cozy young dinos to sleep.

The river sparkled and rolled through the dark,
As Rory curled up on his blanket of green.
Each shadow became just a soft, gentle mark,
Upon the most quiet and slumbering scene.

Now safe in the valley, they all closed their eyes,
As darkness wrapped over the woods like a shawl.
Soft dreams drifted down from the velvety skies,
Goodnight to the dinos, sweet slumber to all.

title: Rory and the Starlight Blossom Valley
verses:
As the moon started climbing the sleepy blue sky,
Rory walked through the forest of shimmering moss.
Where the breeze sang a song that was gentle and high,
And the streams softly rippled in silver across.

Nia swooped through the branches to flutter below,
With Psittaco riding atop of her crest.
They called out to Rory to follow the glow,
To a valley of blossoms where giants could rest.

Ricky bounced down the trail with a sleepy delight,
While Tilly stepped softly on petals of red.
Every leaf started gleaming with violet light,
Making paths for the friends to a velvet-soft bed.

Benny settled his tail on the pillow of grass,
Giving space for the friends as they gathered in line.
They all watched as the clouds started slowly to pass,
While the moon made the quiet old valley to shine.

And Psittaco now settled by Rory's warm side,
While the breeze hummed a lullaby soft through the air.
Underneath the night sky that was open and wide,
Not a worry was left in the peacefulness there.

Rory yawned with a sigh as his heavy eyes closed,
With his friends sleeping soundly together nearby.
In the stillness of evening they sweetly reposed,
While the stars sang a sleepy goodnight from the sky.

title: Rory and the Moonlit Canyon
verses:
As the stars started blinking above in the sky,
Rory walked through the canyon to look at the stream.
And Psittaco chirped from a branch that was high,
To point out a trail with a silver-bright gleam.

Then Ricky skipped past with a leap in his pace,
While Nia flew high on the cool evening breeze.
She guided their steps to a quieter place,
Right under the boughs of the ancient pine trees.

Deep moss covered stones like a soft emerald bed,
Where Benny reclined with a comfortable sigh.
And Tilly rested close as she lowered her head,
To watch all the clouds drifting peacefully by.

Now Psittaco snuggled deep into the fold,
While Ricky leaned back in the shadows to rest.
Warm shadows wrapped over the green and the gold,
As each little creature settled down in its nest.

High up in a branch, Nia folded her wings,
And Rory looked out at the tranquil night air.
The breeze hummed a song that the night-cricket sings,
Bringing peace to the friends who were slumbering there.

Soft shadows fell gently all over the ground,
As dreamland arrived with a quiet embrace.
With sweet heavy sighs and a slumber profound,
The forest grew still in this magical place.

title: Rory and the Silver Moon Cove
verses:
The stars started blinking above the lagoon,
When Nia flew down through the cool evening breeze.
She called out to Rory beneath the soft moon,
To show him a path through the tall whispering trees.

Then Ricky ran forward with hops full of grace,
While Psittaco nestled on Tilly's warm side.
Soft moss made a path to a quiet blue place,
Where Benny walked slow down the sleepy divide.

The water was glowing with bubbles of white,
And blossoms were closing their petals to rest.
Big shadows grew still in the shimmering night,
As birds drifted home to a comfortable nest.

Then Benny lay down on the bank near the stream,
While Rory curled up in a hammock of reed.
The air was as soft as a magical dream,
With all of the rest that the dinosaurs need.

Now Psittaco yawned in the curve of a wing,
As Ricky found shelter beneath a high ledge.
Soft ripples had ceased their low murmur to sing,
And sleepiness gathered around the lake edge.

Deep darkness spread over the cove far and wide,
Where Rory was drifting in dreams of his own.
With Tilly and Benny asleep by his side,
The gentlest of nights in the jungle was known.

title: Rory and the Starlight Cavern
verses:
When evening descended on moss-covered trees,
Then Rory walked slow through the shadowy lane.
Nia swooped down on a whispering breeze,
To guide all her friends from the incoming rain.

Psittaco rested on blankets of leaves,
While Ricky crept over to curl on the floor.
The night-wind blew softly beneath the high eaves,
As Benny let out a grand slumberous snore.

They marched to a canyon where starlight shone clear,
And Tilly stepped first in the glowing blue stream.
The waters ran softly and cool for the year,
To carry each friend to a sleepy young dream.

High up in a cavern of silver and stone,
Where fireflies danced in a circle of light,
Rory sat down with a warmth of his own,
And watched as the valleys turned quiet and white.

Benny lay heavy and still on the moss,
While Nia tucked under a canopy wide.
They counted the sleepy stars drifting across,
With Ricky and Tilly tucked safe at their side.

The shadows grew long as the night settled down,
And Psittaco yawned in a sleepy embrace.
Now Rory closed eyes over forest and town,
As peace settled over this magical place.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
